description:
As a user
  I want to sign in securely
  So that I can access the application

elements.name: Volunteer signs in with valid credentials

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I enter email "volunteer@demo.com"
I enter password "password123"
I click the sign in button
I should be redirected to the dashboard
I should see "Welcome" message

elements.name: Ministry leader signs in with valid credentials

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I enter email "leader@demo.com"
I enter password "password123"
I click the sign in button
I should be redirected to the dashboard
I should see "Ministry Leader" dashboard

elements.name: User fails to sign in with invalid email

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I enter email "nonexistent@demo.com"
I enter password "password123"
I click the sign in button
I should see error message "Invalid credentials"
I should remain on the sign in page

elements.name: User fails to sign in with invalid password

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I enter email "volunteer@demo.com"
I enter password "wrongpassword"
I click the sign in button
I should see error message "Invalid credentials"
I should remain on the sign in page

elements.name: User fails to sign in with empty email

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I leave email empty
I enter password "password123"
I click the sign in button
I should see validation error "Email is required"

elements.name: User fails to sign in with empty password

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am on the sign in page
I enter email "volunteer@demo.com"
I leave password empty
I click the sign in button
I should see validation error "Password is required"

elements.name: User session is maintained after sign in

steps.name: the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am signed in as "volunteer@demo.com"
I navigate to the dashboard
I should remain signed in
I should see my profile information
the application is running
demo users exist in the database
I am signed in as "volunteer@demo.com"
I click the sign out button
I should be redirected to the home page
the session should be cleared

name: User Authentication

description:
As a volunteer
  I want to browse and apply for ministry opportunities
  So that I can find meaningful ways to serve

steps.name: I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am on the opportunities page
I load the page
I should see a list of opportunities
each opportunity should display title, description, and ministry type

elements.name: Volunteer filters opportunities by ministry type

steps.name: I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am on the opportunities page
opportunities from different ministries exist
I select filter "Children's Ministry"
I should only see opportunities from "Children's Ministry"
I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am on the opportunities page
I select the "Sunday School Teacher" opportunity
I click the "Apply Now" button
I should see an application form
I can enter a message about why I want to serve
I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am viewing the "Community Outreach" opportunity
I enter my application message "I have experience with community service"
I click the "Submit Application" button
my application should be recorded
I should see confirmation message "Application submitted successfully"

elements.name: Volunteer cannot apply for same opportunity twice

steps.name: I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I have already applied for "Youth Group Mentor"
I navigate to that opportunity
the "Apply Now" button should be disabled
I should see message "You have already applied for this opportunity"
I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I have submitted applications for 2 opportunities
I navigate to my applications page
I should see all my submitted applications
each should show the status (pending, accepted, rejected)
I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am viewing an opportunity
I scroll to the requirements section
I should see all requirements listed
each requirement should be clearly marked as required or optional
I am signed in as a volunteer
ministry opportunities exist in the database
I am signed in as a ministry leader
I navigate to "Create Opportunity"
I fill in all required fields
I click "Create"
the new opportunity should be visible to volunteers

name: Volunteer Opportunities
